svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 04 · Irvine · 08/12 Eucalyptus Rows (Common)
svg.desc: Long lines of windbreak trees left from ranch days. They creak a little when the afternoon wind comes up. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
